SetAdjustWindowRectSettings.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (SetAdjustWindowRectSettings), ProtoInputLoader Inject.cpp, ProtoInputHooks PipeCommunication.cpp, ProtoInputHooks AdjustWindowRectHook.cpp (Hook_AdjustWindowRect)

SetManualScaling.doc: Rescales the mouse position the game sees (mouse messages, `GetCursorPos`, `GetCursorInfo`) by `oldX`/`newX` and `oldY`/`newY`. Parameters: the instance handle, then `oldX`, `oldY`, `newX`, `newY`; it is ignored unless all four are above 5. Nucleus passes the handler's scale-from size and the player's screen size.
SetManualScaling.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (SetManualScaling), ProtoInputLoader Inject.cpp, ProtoInputHooks PipeCommunication.cpp, ProtoInputHooks WindowMsgHook.cpp (Settings, getfactor), Nucleus ProtoInputLauncher.cs

SetXinputtoMKBkeys.doc: Sets the controller-to-keyboard mapping used by `ProtoInput.SetTranslateXinputtoMKB`. Parameters, in order: the instance handle; virtual-key codes for A, B, X, Y, right shoulder, left shoulder, D-pad right, left, up, down, right stick press, left stick press, stick right, left, up, down, Back and Start; then sensitivity, acceleration and deadzone.
SetXinputtoMKBkeys.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (SetXinputtoMKBkeys), ProtoInputLoader Inject.cpp, ProtoInputHooks PipeCommunication.cpp (SetXinputtoMKBkeys), ProtoInputHooks TranslateXtoMKB.cpp (ButtonStateImpulse, Sens, Sensmult, Deadzone), Nucleus ProtoInputLauncher.cs (defaults)

SetXinputtoMKBCFG.doc: Sets options for `ProtoInput.SetTranslateXinputtoMKB`. Parameters, in order: the instance handle; swap sticks; screen scanning (moves the cursor to points found from .bmp images or static points); shoulder buttons jump to the next point; then for A, B, X and Y in turn: static point, click, move.
SetXinputtoMKBCFG.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (SetXinputtoMKBCFG), ProtoInputLoader Inject.cpp, ProtoInputHooks PipeCommunication.cpp (SetXinputtoMKBCFG, scanAtype...), ProtoInputHooks ScanThread.cpp, TranslateXtoMKB.cpp (lefthanded)

Values.doc: Hook and message filter IDs for `InstallHook`, `EnableMessageFilter`, ...

RegisterRawInputHookID.doc: Selects the RegisterRawInput hook (ID 0): the game's `RegisterRawInputDevices` calls no longer reach Windows, and Proto Input forwards only the assigned mouse and keyboard's raw input to the game's windows. Pair it with `GetRawInputDataHookID`, which decodes the forwarded input. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
RegisterRawInputHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks RegisterRawInputHook.cpp (Hook_RegisterRawInputDevices, InstallImpl), RawInput.cpp (ProcessRawInput)

GetRawInputDataHookID.doc: Selects the GetRawInputData hook (ID 1): when the game reads raw input that Proto Input forwarded, it gets the assigned device's data; other raw input passes through unchanged. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
GetRawInputDataHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks GetRawInputDataHook.cpp (Hook_GetRawInputData), RawInput.cpp (inputBuffer, 0xAB000000 signature)

MessageFilterHookID.doc: Selects the message filter hook (ID 2) on `GetMessage`/`PeekMessage`: messages the game reads carry the fake cursor position, and the enabled filters and blocked messages apply. The `...FilterID` filters and `ProtoInput.EnableMessageBlock` only work while it is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
MessageFilterHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage, InstallImpl)

GetCursorPosHookID.doc: Selects the GetCursorPos hook (ID 3): gives each instance its own cursor position, as `GetCursorPos` returns the instance's fake cursor. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

SetCursorPosHookID.doc: Selects the SetCursorPos hook (ID 4): the game's `SetCursorPos` moves only the instance's fake cursor, not the real one. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

GetKeyStateHookID.doc: Selects the GetKeyState hook (ID 5): `GetKeyState` reports the keys and buttons of the instance's assigned keyboard and mouse. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

GetAsyncKeyStateHookID.doc: Selects the GetAsyncKeyState hook (ID 6): `GetAsyncKeyState` reports the keys and buttons of the instance's assigned keyboard and mouse. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

GetKeyboardStateHookID.doc: Selects the GetKeyboardState hook (ID 7): `GetKeyboardState` reports the keys and buttons of the instance's assigned keyboard and mouse. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

CursorVisibilityStateHookID.doc: Selects the cursor visibility hook (ID 8): the game's `ShowCursor`, `SetCursor` and `SetSystemCursor` calls show, hide and set the image of the instance's fake cursor. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
CursorVisibilityStateHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks CursorVisibilityHook.cpp (Hook_ShowCursor, Hook_SetCursor, Hook_SetSystemCursor)

ClipCursorHookID.doc: Selects the ClipCursor hook (ID 9): the game's `ClipCursor` no longer confines the real cursor; by default it confines the fake cursor instead (see `ProtoInput.SetCursorClipOptions`). Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
ClipCursorHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks ClipCursorHook.cpp (Hook_ClipCursor, Hook_GetClipCursor)

FocusHooksHookID.doc: Selects the focus hooks (ID 10): `GetForegroundWindow`, `GetActiveWindow`, `GetFocus`, `GetCapture` and `WindowFromPoint` return the game's main window, and `SetFocus`, `SetForegroundWindow` and similar calls do nothing, so the game believes it always has focus. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
FocusHooksHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks FocusHook.cpp (GetHwnd, InstallImpl)

RenameHandlesHookID.doc: Selects the rename handles hook (ID 11): mutexes, events, semaphores and named pipes whose names match `ProtoInput.AddHandleToRename` or `ProtoInput.AddNamedPipeToRename` get a unique name, so instances don't block each other. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
RenameHandlesHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks RenameHandlesHook.cpp (updateName, InstallImpl)

XinputHookID.doc: Selects the XInput hook (ID 12): each instance sees only the controllers chosen by `ProtoInput.SetControllerIndex`, in the order given. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
XinputHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks XinputHook.cpp (Hook_XInputGetState, GetTargetControllerIndex, InstallImpl)

DinputOrderHookID.doc: Selects the DirectInput order hook (ID 13): every DirectInput device the game creates opens the controller set by `ProtoInput.SetDinputDeviceGUID`; without one set, DirectInput devices fail to open. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
DinputOrderHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks DinputOrderHook.cpp (Hook_DinputCreateDevice8W, blockDinput)

SetWindowPosHookID.doc: Selects the SetWindowPos hook (ID 14): every `SetWindowPos` call uses the position and size from `ProtoInput.SetSetWindowPosSettings`. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

BlockRawInputHookID.doc: Selects the block raw input hook (ID 15): `GetRawInputDeviceList` and `GetRegisteredRawInputDevices` report no devices to the game. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

FindWindowHookID.doc: Selects the FindWindow hook (ID 16): `FindWindow` and `FindWindowEx` find nothing and `EnumWindows` lists no windows, so an instance can't find another instance's window. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

CreateSingleHIDHookID.doc: Selects the single HID hook (ID 17): once `ProtoInput.SetCreateSingleHIDName` is set, the game can open only that HID device path. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
CreateSingleHIDHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks CreateSingleHIDHook.cpp (Hook_CreateFileW, SetRawHidW)

WindowStyleHookID.doc: Selects the window style hook (ID 18): window styles the game sets with `SetWindowLong`/`SetWindowLongPtr` lose the border, system menu and dialog frame. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

MoveWindowHookID.doc: Selects the MoveWindow hook (ID 19): every `MoveWindow` call uses the position and size from `ProtoInput.SetMoveWindowSettings`. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

AdjustWindowRectHookID.doc: Selects the AdjustWindowRect hook (ID 20): `AdjustWindowRect` and `AdjustWindowRectEx` compute the window size from the rectangle set by `ProtoInput.SetAdjustWindowRectSettings`. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.

RemoveBorderHookID.doc: Selects the remove border hook (ID 21): removes the main window's border and title bar on install (see `ProtoInput.SetDontWaitWindowBorder`), and keeps styles the game sets borderless. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
RemoveBorderHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks RemoveBorderHook.cpp (RemoveWindowBorder, WaitForWindowBorder, InstallImpl)

GetCursorInfoID.doc: Meant to select the GetCursorInfo hook, which makes `GetCursorInfo` report the fake cursor position. In Nucleus this value equals `RemoveBorderHookID` (21), so installing it installs the remove border hook instead. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
GetCursorInfoID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks GetCursorInfoHook.cpp, HookManager.cpp (GetCursorInfoHookID = 22)

SetWindowsHookHookID.doc: Selects the SetWindowsHook hook (ID 23): the game's low-level keyboard, low-level mouse and `GetMessage` hooks are not registered with Windows; Proto Input calls them itself with the instance's input and focus messages. Pass it to `ProtoInput.InstallHook` or `ProtoInput.UninstallHook`.
SetWindowsHookHookID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoHookIDs), ProtoInputHooks SetWindowsHookHook.cpp, FakeMouseKeyboard.cpp, FocusMessageLoop.cpp, RawInput.cpp (FireFake...)

RawInputFilterID.doc: Selects the raw input filter (ID 0): `WM_INPUT` messages always say they arrived while the game was in the foreground. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
RawInputFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks RawInputFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

MouseMoveFilterID.doc: Selects the mouse move filter (ID 1): `WM_MOUSEMOVE` messages carry the instance's fake cursor position and button and modifier state. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
MouseMoveFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks MouseMoveFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

MouseActivateFilterID.doc: Selects the mouse activate filter (ID 2): `WM_MOUSEACTIVATE` messages always tell the game it is being focused. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
MouseActivateFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks MouseActivateFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

WindowActivateFilterID.doc: Selects the window activate filter (ID 3): `WM_ACTIVATE` messages always say the game window is active. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
WindowActivateFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks WindowActivateFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

WindowActivateAppFilterID.doc: Selects the window activate app filter (ID 4): `WM_ACTIVATEAPP` messages always say the game is active. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
WindowActivateAppFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks WindowActivateAppFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

MouseWheelFilterID.doc: Selects the mouse wheel filter (ID 5): only `WM_MOUSEWHEEL` messages synthesized by Proto Input reach the game, so scrolling isn't sent twice. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
MouseWheelFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks MouseWheelFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

MouseButtonFilterID.doc: Selects the mouse button filter (ID 6): only mouse button messages synthesized by Proto Input reach the game, so the real mouse doesn't interfere. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
MouseButtonFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks MouseButtonFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

KeyboardButtonFilterID.doc: Selects the keyboard button filter (ID 7): only `WM_KEYDOWN`/`WM_KEYUP` messages synthesized by Proto Input reach the game, so the real keyboard doesn't interfere. Only acts while `MessageFilterHookID` is installed. Pass it to `ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter` or `ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter`.
KeyboardButtonFilterID.docBasis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs (ExposedValues, ProtoMessageFilterIDs), ProtoInputHooks KeyboardButtonFilter.h, ProtoInputHooks MessageFilterHook.cpp (FilterMessage)

NucleusInstallRoot.doc: The Nucleus install folder (where NucleusCoop.exe is).

GameProfilesFolder.doc: Folder where Nucleus keeps saved game profiles.

NucleusMaxPlayers.doc: Maximum number of players Nucleus supports (32).

IsOneDriveEnabled.doc: True if the Documents folder is inside OneDrive.

IniFile.doc: An INI file opened with `new Nucleus.IniFile(path)`.

IniWriteValue.doc: Sets `Key` in `[Section]` (creating them if needed) and saves the file.

IniReadValue.doc: Reads `Key` from `[Section]`; an empty string if it isn't there.

Folder.doc: Location of a folder used by `Context.GetFolder(...)`.

SaveType.doc: Format of a save/config file for `Context.ModifySaveFile(...)`.

SearchType.doc: How a text line is matched by the text-file helpers.

DPIHandling.doc: How Nucleus compensates for Windows DPI scaling when sizing windows.

DpiAwarenessMode.doc: DPI awareness compatibility flag applied to the game executable.

SetWindowPosHook.doc: Value for `Game.ProtoInput.SetWindowPosHook`. `true` is the same as `True`.

MoveWindowHook.doc: Value for `Game.ProtoInput.MoveWindowHook`. `true` is the same as `True`.

DrawFakeCursor.doc: Value for `Game.ProtoInput.DrawFakeCursor`. `true` is the same as `True`.

PutMouseInsideWindow.doc: Value for `Game.ProtoInput.PutMouseInsideWindow`. `true` is the same as `True`.

SetRemoveBorderHook.doc: Value for `Game.ProtoInput.SetRemoveBorderHook`. `true` is the same as `True`.

IniSaveInfo.doc: A key in an INI file, for `Context.ModifySaveFile(..., Nucleus.SaveType.INI, [...])`.

CfgSaveInfo.doc: A key in a CFG file, for `Context.ModifySaveFile(..., Nucleus.SaveType.CFG, [...])`.

SaveInfo.doc: Base class of save file entries. `Context.ModifySaveFile` skips plain `SaveInfo` entries: use `IniSaveInfo` for INI files and `CfgSaveInfo` for CFG files.

IniFile.doc: Reads and writes keys in an INI file directly (Nucleus.Gaming.IniFile): `var ini = new Nucleus.IniFile(path); ini.IniWriteValue("Section", "Key", "Value");`
